results.text: Good day, and thank you for standing by. [#0](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-0)
Welcome to the Elis H1 2026 Results Presentation Webcast and Conference Call. [#1](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-1)
[Operator Instructions] Please be advised that today's conference is being recorded. [#2](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-2)
I would now like to hand the conference over to Mr. Xavier Martire, CEO. [#4](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-4)
Please go ahead, sir. [#5](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-5)
Thank you. [#7](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-7)
Good afternoon to our participants in Europe, and good morning to everyone joining from across the Americas. [#8](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-8)
Welcome to Elis 2026 Half Year Results Presentation. [#9](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-9)
I'm Xavier Martire, CEO of Elis, speaking to you from Paris, and I'm joined by our CFO, Louis Guyot. [#10](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-10)
I will begin with a brief overview of the key highlights from the first half of the year. [#12](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-12)
Then I will hand over to Louis, who will walk you through the financial results in detail. [#13](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-13)
After that, I will return to share our main CSR achievements and provide an update on our outlook for the remainder of 2026. [#14](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-14)
We then open the floor for Q&A session. [#15](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-15)
And as always, Nicolas Buron will be available after the call to address any further questions. [#16](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-16)
Before we begin, please take a moment to read the disclaimer. [#17](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-17)

The first half of 2026 confirms Elis' ability to deliver resilient, diversified growth in a demanding macroeconomic context marked by a challenging backdrop across the globe. [#19](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-19)

Revenue reached EUR 2,457.1 million in the first half, up 4.9%, including 3.2% organic growth with a similar pace of organic growth in Q2 at 3.2%. [#20](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-20)
Adjusted EBITDA increased by 4.9% to EUR 853.8 million with margin flat year-on-year at 35.7%. [#22](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-22)
Adjusted EBIT rose by plus 4.6% to EUR 370 million with the margin also flat at 15.1%. [#23](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-23)

Headline net income per share was up plus 5.1%, reaching EUR 0.89 on a diluted basis, once again outpacing top line growth, reflecting the accretive effect of our share buyback program. [#24](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-24)
Free cash flow stood at negative EUR 30.1 million. [#26](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-26)

As I will come back to later, this is purely working capital timing effect, and we remain fully on track with the full year trajectory we had in mind. [#27](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-27)
The financial leverage ratio as of June 30, 2026 stood at 2.09x. [#28](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-28)

Despite significant macro headwinds, this performance reflects the continued strength of our model, and I want to highlight five things in particular. [#29](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-29)

Our recent investments in the sales force are clearly paying off with a record level of new contract signings in H1 and continued productivity gains across all geographies supporting margin. [#31](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-31)
The Middle East crisis had no meaningful impact on Elis' activity. [#32](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-32)

Our hedging policy shielded us from energy costs, and the limited cost inflation we did see is being addressed through a dedicated cost-saving plan and targeted pricing actions. [#33](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-33)

We continue to execute on value-accretive bolt-on M&A with four new acquisitions, strengthening our footprint and a pipeline that remains rich heading into H2. [#34](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-34)

And on capital returns, our EUR 500 million share buyback program was completed in mid-July alongside the planned exercise of the soft call option on our OCEANE 2029 convertible bond. [#36](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-36)

Taken together, this gives us confidence to confirm all of our 2026 financial objectives on the back of the expected sequential improvement in the second half. [#37](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-37)
Let's now move on the next slide, which focus on top line growth drivers in the first half of '26. [#39](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-39)
Our recent investments in the sales force are paying off. [#40](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-40)

The group reached a record level of new contract signing in H1, capturing strong outsourcing demand across all geography with new client wins outpacing churn and cross-selling of growth services, Flat Linen, Workwear, Hygiene, gaining traction. [#41](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-41)
We will come back to this in more detail shortly as we go through each of our geographies. [#42](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-42)

On pricing, we implemented adjustments across our full geographic footprint in the context of high cost base inflation, especially on workforce costs. [#44](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-44)
Importantly, we saw no significant direct activity derived from geopolitics. [#45](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-45)

Bolt-on acquisition added plus 1.1% to H1 growth, consistent with our value-accretive consolidation strategy in fragmented market and our pipeline remains rich leading into the second half. [#46](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-46)
Finally, we recorded a plus 0.6% FX tailwind, reflecting favorable Latin American currency trends. [#47](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-47)

Let's now turn to Slide 7, which highlights our long-term ambition to replicate the successful French model in terms of footprint, scale and breadth of services across all our geographies. [#49](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-49)

Strong momentum in Workwear continued driven by the acceleration in outsourcing, and we recorded additional cross-selling successes in pest control and clean room. [#50](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-50)

As local network density increase, we continue to progressive rollout -- the progressive rollout of our services offer to small clients. [#52](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-52)
This strategy remains a key lever for organic growth. [#53](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-53)

Elis is continuously reinforcing its sales force in many countries to harness this organic growth opportunity and we remain committed to investing in local sales team going forward. [#54](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-54)

As already mentioned, we are clearly seeing these investments pay off where they have been made, and we'll come back to this in more detail as we go through geography. [#55](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-55)
Our ultimate goal remains unchanged, replicate the French footprint and service launch in all our other geographies. [#56](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-56)
Moving on to the next slide. [#58](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-58)
Let me spend a moment on the macro backdrop, which remained difficult across Europe in the first half. [#59](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-59)
France posting record high insolvencies, Germany, its highest level of Q2 corporate insolvency since 2005 to name just two examples. [#60](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-60)

Despite the very global European macro environment, this slide presents Elis organic revenue growth in H1 across a number of our European markets. [#61](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-61)

And as you can see, the trend remains solid despite the difficult context with group organic growth comfortably above 3% over the period. [#62](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-62)
This isn't about chasing spectacular growth in any single market. [#63](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-63)

It's about the structural resilient nature of the markets we operate in and outsourcing trends that keep advancing regardless of the broader economic cycle. [#64](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-64)
That's precisely what allows us to keep delivering solid growth year in, year out even when the macro backdrop turns difficult. [#66](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-66)
This is once again the clearest illustration of the resilience of our diversified model in a challenging macro environment. [#67](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-67)
Turning to the next slide. [#69](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-69)
Let me address the Middle East crisis directly as I know it's on many of your minds. [#70](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-70)

So in Q1, hospitality activity in Paris was briefly penalized by lower hotel occupancy following the outbreak of the conflict, but with a rapid return to normal. [#71](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-71)
We saw no transport disruption for our Asia sourced linen. [#72](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-72)
On costs, we did see a material increase in gas and electricity spot prices since the beginning of the conflict of around plus 50%. [#73](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-73)
Thanks to our progressive hedging policy, roughly 1/3 of volumes locked in each year for N+3, '26, '27 and '28 are largely shield. [#75](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-75)
We are 93% hedged on gas and 94% on electricity for '26, 81% and 87% respectively for '27 and 61% and 53% for '28. [#76](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-76)

We did see some inflation on other commodities used by the group, fuel, paper and chemicals, representing a EUR 7 million impact on cost in H1. [#77](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-77)
To address this temporary cost increase, the cost saving plan has been implemented alongside additional temporary pricing surcharges. [#78](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-78)
And looking further out, our 2027 pricing indexation should be strong, reflecting the evolution of oil prices. [#79](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-79)

All told, we expect energy cost of around EUR 190 million in '26 below the '25 level, and we have already secured a further reduction for 2027. [#80](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-80)
Moving on to Slide 10. [#82](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-82)
Let me highlight two of our fastest growing activities. [#83](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-83)
Clean room posted plus 6% revenue growth in H1, reaching EUR 145 million, supported by favorable market drivers. [#84](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-84)

We operate in a structurally growing clean room market at plus 5% to plus 7% per annum, driven by pharma, biotech and semiconductor investments. [#85](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-85)

We continue to differentiate through innovation, real-time monitoring, connected devices, smart garment, predictive analytics and our international footprint supports growing demand for rationalization and harmonization at key accounts. [#86](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-86)
Pest Control posted plus 16% volume growth in H1, reaching EUR 45 million. [#88](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-88)

Growth was broad-based across all geographies where the service is deployed and solid execution by our dedicated pest control team supported continued expansion. [#89](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-89)

Our growing network of regional technical centers and sales representatives is driving growth ahead of the overall market in a highly fragmented industry. [#90](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-90)
Let's now take a look at each of our geographies, starting with France. [#92](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-92)

So France delivered good commercial dynamism across segments in the first half with revenue growth at plus 2.5%, of which plus 2% was organic. [#93](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-93)

Hospitality showed an encouraging level of activity despite the slight decrease in Paris hotel occupancy in Q1 with a rapid return to normal and some softness during the June heat wave. [#94](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-94)
Pricing adjustments implemented at the start of the year helped to offset labor cost inflation. [#95](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-95)

The EBITDA margin further improved to 42.7%, up plus 90 bps driven by sustained operational efficiency, workshop productivity, logistic optimization, lower water and energy consumption and improved purchasing condition. [#97](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-97)
Moving on to next 12. [#99](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-99)
Central Europe posted revenue growth of plus 5.9% in the first half, including plus 3.2% organic growth. [#100](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-100)

We recorded many commercial successes in Workwear in both standard and cleanroom despite a difficult macro environment and performance was solid in Belux, Poland and the Czech Republic. [#101](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-101)

Growth in Germany was still impacted by a selective commercial approach in the Healthcare segment, reflecting ongoing budget pressures on clients. [#103](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-103)
Nevertheless, some encouraging signs are emerging with improving churn and some new signings to be implemented towards year-end. [#104](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-104)

We are also seeing interesting developments in the nursing home market with growing outsourcing driven by a search for higher quality of service. [#105](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-105)
And this is a promising market where we intend to step up our focus going forward. [#106](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-106)

We also secured a contract with a leading German private Healthcare group to be implemented in late H2, which is expected to bring around 20 million in additional revenue on this contract in '27. [#108](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-108)
Four acquisition in Germany and Switzerland contributed to plus 2.3% in the half year growth. [#109](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-109)

On profitability, the EBITDA margin came in at 32% in H1, down 30 basis points, reflecting the temporary dilutive effect from the numerous acquisition in the region as well as a significant increase in the minimum legal salary in Germany, which remains difficult to fully pass through. [#111](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-111)
Moving on to the next slide. [#113](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-113)

Scandinavia and Eastern Europe is a region made up of relatively small mature markets where the group already holds a strong market position. [#114](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-114)
Reported revenue was up plus 3.4%, including plus 1.6% organic growth  -- of organic. [#115](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-115)

Finland, Norway and the Baltics are still benefiting from outsourcing demand and the competitive environment normalized in Denmark even if the markets remain subdued overall. [#116](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-116)
We also benefited from a plus 1.8% positive FX impact on half year growth. [#117](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-117)
The EBITDA margin improved slightly by 10 basis points to 34.5%. [#119](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-119)
The margin is now stabilized at a high level. [#120](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-120)
Limited top line growth currently makes it difficult to benefit from operating leverage. [#121](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-121)
Moving on to the next slide. [#123](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-123)
Let's now turn to the U.K. and Ireland. [#124](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-124)
Organic revenue growth ended well at plus 1.6% in the first half. [#125](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-125)

Reported revenue, however, was down minus 0.8%, reflecting the negative evolution of the British pound, which had a minus 2.4% impact on revenue. [#126](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-126)

Despite a difficult macro environment, the U.K. performed well with strong contract wins in hospitality supported by an expanded sales force and Elis recognized quality of service, all while maintaining pricing discipline and a selective approach to winning new clients. [#127](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-127)
Healthcare, for its part, remains stable. [#128](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-128)
Turning to Ireland, the picture was more challenging with increased competition in hospitality weighing on performance. [#130](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-130)

The EBITDA margin of the region came in at 31.8%, down 10 bps. The significant U.K. minimum wage increase remains difficult to fully pass through in a competitive environment. [#131](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-131)
Let's now move on to Latin America. [#133](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-133)

Revenue was up plus 15.4% in the first half, including plus 8% organic growth and benefited from a plus 5.6% positive impact from local currency movement. [#134](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-134)
Brazil delivered solid commercial performance, posting plus 8.6% organic growth in H1. [#135](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-135)

In Mexico meanwhile, a public tender has been launched to reset all volumes following a reorganization of the Mexican federal healthcare system. [#136](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-136)

This tender was previously structured as a single lot but has now shifted to a multi-lot format and a diversifying supplier to optimize prices even at the potential expense of the service quality as the phenomenon that we have already seen play out in the Healthcare market in Europe in the past. [#137](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-137)

As a result, 50% of the volume has been lost, representing around EUR 2 million per month since June or an expected EUR 14 million impact on full year 2026. [#139](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-139)

That said, despite this episode, revenue in Mexico still stands more than 36% above its level at our entry into the country in '22 in local currency, and this should be kept in [perspective]. [#140](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-140)

More broadly, this is naturally part of the business we operate in tenders get reset, contracts get won and lost, and it is worth weighing this against the German Healthcare add-on I mentioned a moment ago. [#141](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-141)

Across our footprint, these puts and takes tend to balance out over time, and this is precisely why our diversified model continues to deliver resilient growth overall. [#143](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-143)

Against this backdrop, the group continues to expand its offering in Mexico, notably with Workwear for industry and Flat Linen for hospitality, while in Brazil, the acquisition of Aquaflash contributed to plus 1.8% to H1 growth. [#144](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-144)

On the profitability side, the EBITDA margin declined by 180 bps to 30.8%, impacted by workforce cost increase in the region and by the volume losses in Mexico. [#146](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-146)

Labor cost inflation has been particularly strong since the start of the year with, for instance, a plus 23% minimum wage increase in Colombia and a plus 13% increase in Mexico, and this could not be fully passed through to pricing in H1, reflecting the typical lag between cost increase and pricing adjustments, an effect set to ease in H2. [#147](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-147)
The Mexico volume loss late in H1 temporarily lower capacity utilization. [#148](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-148)
The necessary operation adjustment have since been implemented to limit the impact on margin. [#149](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-149)
We now conclude our geographic review on Slide 16 with Southern Europe. [#151](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-151)
Reported revenue increased by 8.1%, included 5.7% organic growth. [#152](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-152)

We recorded many commercial successes in all geographies, notably in workwear and performance was strong in Spain, supported by a good start to the summer season in hospitality. [#153](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-153)
Acquisition in Spain contributed 2.4% to growth. [#154](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-154)

On profitability, EBITDA margin further improved in H1 to 32.1%, up 30 basis points, driven by industrial process optimization delivering further productivity gains. [#155](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-155)
Solid top line growth also generated some operating leverage helping margin progression. [#156](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-156)
Moving on to the next slide to conclude on M&A. [#158](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-158)

The group continued to execute its targeted bolt-on acquisition strategy with M&A contributing plus 1.1% to revenue growth in the first half. [#159](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-159)
Four recent acquisitions have further strengthened our presence in key geographies and strategic market segments. [#160](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-160)

In Germany, we acquired Adrett located in Schuby close to the Danish border offering rental services for Flat Linen and serving hospitality customer with EUR 12 million of revenue in '25. [#162](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-162)

In Switzerland, we acquired Wäsche Perle one laundry facility in Interlaken at the heart of one of Switzerland's leading tourist destinations, addressing Flat Linen for hospitality clients with EUR 13.5 million of revenue in '25. [#164](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-164)

In Spain, we acquired RS10, one plant located in the northeast of Barcelona, servicing healthcare customer primarily and hospitality clients in both Flat Linen and Workwear with EUR 5.5 million of revenue in '25. [#166](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-166)

And in Brazil, we acquired ServBrasil in July, which operates from 20 small-scale laundry across five states in the Central and Northeastern regions in the country located directly within its client facilities, serving isolated hospitals with Flat Linen rental and maintenance services. [#168](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-168)
It generated EUR 5 million of revenue in '25. [#169](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-169)
This is a new client source for the group of the Brazilian market, and we are very excited about the opportunity. [#171](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-171)
All these acquisitions are fully aligned with our bolt-on strategy and our pipeline remains very solid heading into H2. [#173](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-173)
With that, I will now hand over to Louis, who will provide more detail on our H1 '26 financial performance. [#174](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-174)
Thank you, Xavier. [#176](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-176)
Good afternoon, everyone. [#177](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-177)
Let us start with this chart that we like a lot and the best testimony of our success. [#178](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-178)

It illustrates the evolution of Elis revenue and EBITDA margin over 25 years and demonstrates the resilience and profitability of our business model. [#179](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-179)
You see indeed a regular growth with some push from major deals while keeping the margin in a narrow bandwidth whatever happens. [#181](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-181)

Indeed, you see on this chart the 2009 financial crisis, the 2012 social crisis, the COVID period, the energy crisis, wage inflation and so on. [#182](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-182)
